name: Power Of Attorney Requirements
definition: Specifies the conditions to be filled in to obtain a valid power of attorney.

LegalRequirement.name: Legal Requirement
LegalRequirement.definition: Specifies whether the power of attorney needs to be validated by some authority.

OtherDocumentation.definition: Specifies the documents needed to obtain a valid power of attorney.

PowerOfAttorney.name: Power Of Attorney
PowerOfAttorney.definition: Power of attorney for which the requirements are provided.
